messages:
violet: Quick follow-up from P-356 postmortem (kv cache oscillation). We need owners, short deadlines, and concrete runbook/playbook edits: triage commands, rollback, and a clear escalation ladder. PM notes: https://redwood.internal/pm/p-356 :link:

samir: I can own the config remediation + canary deploy. Plan: reproduce in staging by Tue, submit helm values PR Wed, small prod canary Fri.

nora: I'll own the runbook and playbook changes. I want a 4-step first-responder checklist and copy-paste commands. PR target Thu morning.

runbooks-bot: Current playbook link: https://playbooks.redwood/cache-ops (v3). Suggest adding section "P-356 addendum".

samir: Draft triage snippet to add:

```bash
# check eviction and latency
curl -sS http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep cache_eviction_rate || true
curl -sS http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep request_tail_latency_ms || true

# increase cache size and restart via helm
helm upgrade kv-cache charts/kv-cache -f values.yaml --set cache.maxEntries=300000
kubectl rollout status deploy/kv-cache -w --timeout=120s
```

nora: Good. I'll add a short rollback snippet:

```bash
# rollback to previous helm release
helm rollback kv-cache 2
kubectl rollout status deploy/kv-cache -w
```

violet: Escalation ladder proposal: responder -> SRE oncall (5m) -> Dedicated capacity lead (10m) -> Eng infra (20m). Also add fallback: switch routing to `redwood-stable` when 95th percentile latency > 600ms for 2m. Include API example.

pagerduty-bot: Current policy: P1 -> 3m ack -> escalate to SRE -> 8m escalate to Dedicated Capacity.

samir: Monitoring: add two alert severities on `cache_eviction_rate`: WARN at 2x baseline -> #incidents; SEV at 4x baseline -> page SRE + Dedicated. Recurrence rule: if SEV fires 3x in 14d, auto-create follow-up ticket and assign owners. I'll open alert PR Wed.

nora: Runbook edits to include: triage commands (above), rollback steps, explicit escalation ladder, alert thresholds, and the routing fallback API snippet. I'll open PR Thu AM and tag @samir for review.

violet: I'll schedule a 30m weekly sync with owners until items closed. Owners & deadlines summary:
- samir: reproduce staging Tue; helm PR Wed; prod canary Fri
- nora: runbook/playbook PR Thu AM

violet: React with :white_check_mark: when you accept. I'll close once PR links and ticket number are posted.
